card.title: Don’t Let Reality Notice
card.instruction: Behave as though openly questioning the impossible premise could attract dangerous attention, and respond to doubt with urgent normality.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lower your voice about the singing moon. We don't want it noticing us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then call it weather. Weather gets away with anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's singing my name. Should I answer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only with 'Lovely evening.' Keep walking. We're just two people discussing the forecast.

mechanism: A fears the singing moon will notice them and uses ordinary weather talk as cover when it addresses B directly.
confusable: Unlike embarrassment about not understanding magic, A is avoiding dangerous attention by controlling the public response to doubt.
comparison: The moon alternative handles direct naming with a bland greeting; the chair alternative disguises rescue logistics as ordinary dining arrangements.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
